name: com.cave.bwaudio
description: Unity control client for the bwaudio spatial-audio engine: a thin P/Invoke binding over the engine's C ABI (no audio crosses the boundary, only control). Drives a 26-speaker CAVE array over ASIO/Dante with a binaural debug monitor. Provides a centralized per-frame push (BwAudio) and a positional emitter (BwEmitter).
